The Wonders of Machine Perception: Sensors and What Lies Behind Them
The Signals and Systems Research Group focuses on integrating mathematical modeling with artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms. The resulting methods require significantly fewer training resources, while their mathematically grounded, model-driven architecture ensures transparent and interpretable decision-making. These results are broadly applicable across various fields of signal processing, including medical and engineering applications. This video presents a proprietary model-driven, AI-based signal processing system that utilizes data from a sensor embedded in a tire to identify road type and road surface quality in real time, and to estimate the tire–road friction coefficient.

The weak prerequisite
▪ Can be taken in the same semester as the follow-up subject, but you 
must complete it first before you pass the follow-up. 
▪ If not completed, your grade in the follow-up subject will automatically be 
failed/unfulfilled even if you pass its exam! 
▪ Imagine a locked door: you can only pass through the door if you have a 
key. In this case, you can only pass the follow-up subject (door) if you have 
a key to open the lock (the completed prerequisite subject).
▪ If you register for the follow-up subject, but you cannot pass it in a 
given semester due to a failed prerequisite, the follow-up subject will 
not be counted into the maximum 3 subject registrations/subject limit 
during your studies (regarding termination of student status).

History of the faculty
The Hungarian tertiary education is about the same age as the other institutions of the Central-European region. EÖTVÖS Loránd University which is the biggest and oldest one in Hungary was founded on the 12th of May 1635 by Cardinal Péter PÁZMÁNY (1570–1637) as a catholic institution. Its original location was in Nagyszombat, North-West Hungary (now Trnava in Slovakia), since large areas of Hungary were at that time the subject of continual dispute with the Ottoman Empire.

content: The original faculties were Theology and Philosophy, and the university had the right to give scientific degrees. Though the university had a strong catholic character, the curriculum from the very beginning included mathematics and natural sciences, like physics and cartography. In 1667 was the foundation of the Faculty of Law and the Faculty of Medicine was the following more than a century later, in 1769. Thus the classical European university structure of four faculties was established, and state control was introduced in the same year by Empress Maria Theresia, who gave it the new name of the Royal Hungarian University (Magyar Királyi Tudományegyetem).

content: The Turks were expelled from Hungary at the turn of the XVII-XVIIIth centuries and Buda (the western part of Budapest) slowly regained its role as capital of the country. The university was moved to Buda in 1777. In the next decades its faculties were distributed among several buildings in Buda and Pest. The prosperity of the second half of the XIXth century made it possible to build the campus on Museum Ring (Múzeum körút), which is now the location of several departments of the Faculty of Humanities. In addition, the ever-growing university acquired new buildings – more than 100 by now – spread out all over Budapest. content: The structure of the university remained unaltered for almost two hundred years, up to 1950, when significant changes were brought about by the communist takeover. The Faculty of Theology was expelled from the university on ideological grounds, and the Faculty of Medicine became the independent SEMMELWEIS Medical University. The Faculty of Philosophy and Arts was divided into the Faculties of Science and Arts. A recent change was the opening of the new campus in South Buda (Lágymányos). In 1950 the university was re-named after Baron Loránd EÖTVÖS (1848–1919), a Professor of Physics of considerable reputation (experimental evidence for the equivalence of gravitational and inertial mass) and an eminent statesman.

content:
After the change of the political system (about 1989) the number of students grew rapidly. The university got back the right of PhD issuance in 1993. In 2000 two high schools were integrated into the university.
Since 2003 there are 8 faculties: Faculty of Arts, Faculty of Informatics, Faculty of Law, Faculty of Elementary and Nursery School Teachers' Training, Faculty of Education and Psychology, Faculty of Science, Faculty of Social Sciences and “BÁRCZI Gusztáv” Faculty of Special Education.

Residence Permit for the Purpose of Job Seeking or Starting a Business 
ELTE’s Guide for Students 
 
 
In case you wish to extend your stay in Hungary after your graduation to search for a job, you may wish to apply for a residence 
permit for the purpose of seeking a job or starting a business. 
 
You can only apply for this permit in a specific set of circumstances: 
 
1) you need to submit the application when your residence permit is still valid; 
2) you have to submit a copy of your diploma (that you can only have after your graduation) as soon as possible, but within a 
couple of weeks after submitting the application at the latest. 
 
It is possible that you will need to submit the application without your diploma. In this case, submit a letter of explanation in

metadata.source: ..\data\raw\linked_pdfs\Job%20seeking%20permit%20guide.pdf
metadata.file_name: Job%20seeking%20permit%20guide.pdf
metadata.creator: PyPDF
metadata.author: Nagy Benedek
metadata.title: Microsoft Word - Job seeking permit

content:
It is possible that you will need to submit the application without your diploma. In this case, submit a letter of explanation in 
which you state that you are in the process of getting your diploma that you shall upload as soon as possible. It is beneficial to also 
upload a letter from your faculty that states what is the expected date of your graduation. 
 
You will need to visit the authorities at Szegedi út 35-37 within 15 days after the online submission, and the personal visit needs to 
take place before the expiry of your residence permit card, otherwise your application will automatically be rejected. If you have an 
ongoing residence permit application, you will be able to get a temporary residence certificate from the authorities. You should ask

metadata.source: ..\data\raw\linked_pdfs\Job%20seeking%20permit%20guide.pdf

content:
ongoing residence permit application, you will be able to get a temporary residence certificate from the authorities. You should ask 
for this during your personal visit. 
 
After the submission, the authorities will send you an official notification, asking you to supplement your application with 
additional documents (mainly your diploma). They will give you a set amount of time. If you cannot get your diploma by then, you 
will need to ask in an official letter for an extension of the supplementory period, so that you can upload your diploma in time.

ELTE’s Guide for Students 
 
When lodging the application for residence permit for the purpose of job-searching or entrepreneurship, the third-country national 
researcher shall enclose with the application: 
 
a) one facial photograph; 
b) documentary evidence verifying compliance with the requirements set out in Paragraphs a) and f)-i) of Subsection (1) of 
Section 17 of Act XC/2023; 
[meaning: passport; proof of finances (bank account statement showing that you have enough money to support your 
stay in Hungary); health insurance or proof of finances that shows that you will be able to cover any health related

stay in Hungary); health insurance or proof of finances that shows that you will be able to cover any health related 
costs; not being expelled or banned, not posing national security risks; not having an SIS warning against you] 
c) reliable form of evidence of seeking employment or launching a business in Hungary; and 
[meaning: a) certificate of registration by the competent government employment agency upon applying for 
services; b) document made out and duly signed by a business association registered in Hungary evidencing that the 
third-country national has signed up to commence employment within three months following the date of submission of 
the application.] 
d) the third-country national’s statement undertaking the commitment of voluntary departure from the territory of the

the application.] 
d) the third-country national’s statement undertaking the commitment of voluntary departure from the territory of the 
Member States of the European Union and other Schengen States in accordance with Subsection (3) of Section 111 of Act 
XC/2023 if the application is refused. 
 
Please be advised this section refers to serving proof of the applicant’s purpose of stay, a certificate issued by the competent 
national employment body stating that you are registered as a service requester refers to a certificate issued by the Labor 
Office of the Goverment Offices. You may register as a job seeker to fulfill the critera for the job seeking permit once you no longer

metadata.source: ..\data\raw\linked_pdfs\Job%20seeking%20permit%20guide.pdf

content:
Office of the Goverment Offices. You may register as a job seeker to fulfill the critera for the job seeking permit once you no longer 
have an active student status. (Act IV . of 1991, 58. § (5) d) 2.) Nevertheless, like the the presentation of the degree, this can be 
remedied after the permit application, which is to be filed as long as you still have a valid study permit. With regards to the health 
insurance, it may be covered by a significant sum on your bank account, but it is safer and recommended to have an actual health

What is the difference between a visa and a residence permit?
The visa is a travel document. The residence permit visa (D-visa) can be issued for a maximum of 3 months, and one can enter Hungary with it only once. If one does not arrive in Hungary while the visa is valid, the residence permit that is issued along with the visa will be automatically canceled by the authorities.

Can I switch from a residence permit for the purpose of employment to a res. perm. for the purpose of studies?
If the res. perm. for the purpose of employment expires or gets terminated, or the student holding it wishes to switch to a res. perm. for the purpose of studies, special rules may apply. Non-EEA students without a visa-waiver passport cannot apply for a res. perm. for the purpose of studies from within Hungary, as they need to travel home and apply for the permit through a Hungarian consulate/embassy, even if they have/had a valid res. perm. for the purpose of employment. If the non-EEA student has a visa-waiver passport, they can use their visa-free days to apply for a res. perm. for the purpose of studies from Hungary without traveling home.

content: It is worthy to mention that a res. perm. for the purpose of employment is invalidated if the student no longer works at the same company, whereas a res. perm. for the purpose of studies remains valid as long as one has an active semester. However, a res. perm. for the purpose of studies is invalidated if you have a passive semester, whereas a res. perm. for the purpose of employment is only tied to the work status, and the student status does not affect it.

content:
To conclude, students are generally advised to have a residence permit for the purpose of studies, as it usually provides more flexibility and can be safer for students. It also allows students to work (see the previous answer). Nevertheless, students wishing to work full-time may continue studying at ELTE with a res. perm. for the purpose of employment without changing their permits in case it suits them better than a res. perm. for the purpose of studies.
Is it possible for my family members to obtain a residence permit for the purpose of family reunification?
A third-country national holding or applying for a residence permit for the purpose of studies shall not be granted a residence permit for the purpose of family reunification.

Do I need an invitation letter to host my family/friends in Hungary?
The invitation letter document no longer exists. It is not necessary to get a C-visa, therefore the university cannot issue such a document. However, the faculties can issue certificates about the dates of graduation ceremonies.
